svg.title: An independent oracle catches a mistake that an implementation-derived snapshot preserves
svg.desc: Requirements and input derive an expected inventory independently from the replacement implementation. Their maps disagree about P100. A snapshot copied from the actual output instead reproduces the omission and passes by agreement.
svg.text: Two sources for expected behavior give different checks
Fictional inventory fixture · identical state and input throughout
Initial P100: 4 · import P201: 3 and P202: 2
Create-only contract: add new SKUs and retain existing stock.
Implementation path
Fault: replace the inventory map
Independent oracle path
Requirement + reviewed fixture
Actual output
P100 missing · total 5
Expected inventory
Total 9 · retain every entry
Independent map comparison: FAIL — P100 is missing
The requirement supplies an expectation the code can contradict.
Self-derived snapshot: copy the actual output into “expected”
Same faulty map compared with itself: PASS, with P100 still absent.
That agreement does not establish the create-only contract.
Arrows: provenance of actual and expected values, not execution time
